items.title: [Remote/HK] Quant/Web3公司诚聘  Rust量化， C++低延迟，机构BDM，量化策略研究员（高频交易与做市），项目经理/项目总监（PMO），财务经理，斯巴达业务负责人，资深量化风险专家（交易与对冲），资深量化交易专家（对冲策略） 薪水RMB/USD
items.description:
## 公司/团队介绍
将人工智能深度融入去中心化交易协议，为机构与零售用户提供现货、高杠杆永续/交割合约及美式/欧式期权等结构化产品。团队远程优先，办公室覆盖香港、新加坡、加拿大、欧盟及北美，成员兼具投行、高频做市、量化对冲、FAANG 及区块链底层研发背景，依托全球低延迟交易设施与 AI 风控引擎，实现 7×24 小时跨时区流动性供给与 Delta 中性对冲。

## 薪资福利待遇
$5K/月-10K/月， $10K-20K/月。

## 地点

- 工作地点：Remote & HK
- 联系方式：justinxu268@gmail.com / TG：@jtx_2023

## 工作性质

- 是否全职：是
- 是否远程：是 & 否
- 时区要求：（GMT+8优先，可覆盖核心工作时间，可适应国际分布式团队协作）
  
## 岗位要求、职责
Position 一：C++低延迟交易系统工程师（Full-Time，Onsite-HK，提供 EP）
岗位职责： 
负责用现代 C++ 开发并优化加密衍生品高频交易系统，覆盖行情、订单管理、执行、风控、仓位与监控等核心模块。负责交易所 API 连接、低延迟链路优化及线上故障排查，保障系统稳定高效运行。
任职要求： 
本科以上学历，2–7 年 C++ 低延迟或交易系统相关经验。熟悉 Linux、多线程、网络编程和衍生品订单生命周期。有 HFT/做市/OMS/交易所 API 经验，或熟悉 NUMA、lock-free、DPDK/RDMA、Rust/Python/K8s 者优先。

Position 二：量化策略研究员（高频交易与做市）（Full-Time，Onsite-HK，提供 EP）
岗位职责： 
负责研究加密货币衍生品高频、做市及短周期策略，分析订单簿与订单流特征。构建考虑手续费、滑点、排队和延迟的回测仿真，并优化报价、库存、对冲及实盘验证。
任职要求： 
本科以上学历，2–7 年量化、算法交易或做市经验。具备 Crypto 衍生品研究、概率统计与 Python 回测能力，熟悉执行约束和偏差识别。有永续/期货做市、订单流建模、C++/ClickHouse 经验者优先。

Position 三：机构 BDM（Full-Time，Onsite-HK，提供 EP）
岗位职责： 
负责开发维护机构客户、交易公司和战略伙伴，推动区域及国际业务拓展。协调客户接入、代表公司参会并维护长期合作关系，支持业务持续增长。
任职要求： 
本科以上学历，2–8 年机构销售、业务拓展或合作管理经验。具备 Crypto、衍生品及机构交易生态背景，中英文流利。有港新跨境市场、交易所/做市商/流动性资源者优先。

Position 四：项目经理/项目总监（PMO）（Full-Time，Remote）
岗位职责： 
负责支持增长、市场及运营项目的执行推进、跨团队协作、交付跟进和风险升级。推动项目管理流程标准化、模板/SOP 搭建及复盘优化。
任职要求： 
2–10 年 PMO、项目管理或运营协调经验，有增长、市场或运营合作经验。必须项为二线交易所背景，以及市场活动或增长项目经验。需能独立强势推动项目，不要执行岗。

Position 五：财务经理（Full-Time，Remote）
岗位职责： 
熟悉交易所资金全业务，负责多币种、多主体全盘账务、月结年结及报表差异分析。对接产研梳理财务需求，搭建优化对账核算系统，并管理冷热钱包、银行账户、代币台账、链上对账和内控流程。
任职要求： 
财务/金融本科，3 年以上 Web3/加密交易所财务全盘经验。懂 Etherscan/Tronscan 链上对账，能独立对接产研提需求并输出正确报表。Base 迪拜优先，有财务系统 0–1 经验，不要执行岗。

Position 六：斯巴达业务负责人（Full-Time，Remote）
岗位职责： 
作为核心业务线负责人，负责斯巴达业务整体规划、运营与增长。精通跟单、带单、机器人交易产品运作规则，并推动业务落地和持续优化。
任职要求： 
需传统金融背景，证券背景优先，熟悉基金产品运作，且最近 2 年必须深耕加密货币行业。精通跟单、带单、机器人交易产品运作规则。必须业务精通达到负责人级别，执行岗不看。

Position 七：资深量化风险专家（交易与对冲）（Full-Time，Remote）
岗位职责： 
建立覆盖场内交易、外部对冲和通道资金的风险分析体系，负责逐币种/账户/组合风险模型、限额阈值、压力测试及异常流量与逆向选择/markout 分析。独立检验对冲策略并进行事故归因，用 Python/SQL 推动风控生产化。
任职要求： 
5 年以上市场/量化风险或衍生品交易经验，熟练 Python/SQL。深入理解永续期货、保证金、强平、资金费、基差、市场微观结构、VaR/ES 与压力测试。有主导风险框架和事件改进案例，纯合规/反洗钱/告警值守不匹配。

Position 八：资深量化交易专家（对冲策略）（Full-Time，Remote）
岗位职责： 
在批准的风险预算和资金约束内，对对冲业务净收益负责，研究动态对冲比例、净额聚合、库存控制与再平衡。优化跨通道路由、Maker/Taker、拆单与执行节奏，主导 TCA、损益归因及策略从研究到实盘的完整生命周期。
任职要求： 
5 年以上量化交易、系统化做市或电子交易经验，至少 2 年实盘策略与 P&L 管理经验，熟练 Python/SQL。有主导研究进入实盘并持续运行的案例。必须具备独立交易经验，不要执行岗。

## 工作环境
弹性工作，非常扁平，典型工程师文化氛围，稳定性高。

- Lead the team to develop the digital bank system from scratch
- Overall project management including planning, tracking, risk management, stakeholder management, quality assurance etc.
- Build and manage development teams across three countries: Japan, India, and Vietnam
- Build & tracking engineering process follow Scrum/Agile framework
- Taking responsibility for Scrum Master of the team

- Review code, provide insights, and set up coding standards for the project.
- Design system operations and maintenance with a view from the development stage to post-release
- After release, efficiently and safely conduct additional system development, operations, and maintenance
- Ensure regular reports to management.

items.title: [Remoto] Full Stack Developer (React) Pleno na Rotha IA
items.description:
## Nossa empresa

A Rotha IA cria sistemas de gestão sob medida (CRMs e ERPs) para empresas de diferentes setores, com React, TypeScript e Supabase.

## Descrição da vaga

Profissional para desenvolver, evoluir e sustentar de ponta a ponta os sistemas de gestão web dos nossos clientes, com autonomia para decidir como resolver cada problema.

- Desenvolver e evoluir aplicações com React, TypeScript e Next.js, do front-end ao banco de dados.
- Modelar o banco no Supabase (PostgreSQL): tabelas, RLS, funções, gatilhos e migrations sem derrubar a produção.
- Projetar integrações com serviços externos (nota fiscal, pagamentos, WhatsApp), tratando webhooks, novas tentativas e duplicidade.
- Publicar versões e aplicar mudanças de banco em produção com autonomia.
- Resolver problemas de desempenho, consultas lentas e inconsistência de dados.
- Receber pedidos dos clientes, propor a solução técnica e estimar o prazo.
- Escrever testes automatizados e cuidar da qualidade do build e da publicação.
- Revisar código e apoiar pessoas com menos experiência.
- Documentar decisões técnicas, padrões e rotinas críticas.

## Local

Remoto (100%), Brasil.

## Requisitos

**Obrigatórios:**
- Ensino superior completo ou em andamento em Computação, Sistemas de Informação, Engenharia de Software, ADS ou área relacionada.
- Pelo menos 3 anos com desenvolvimento web, com pelo menos um sistema em produção usado por clientes.
- Domínio de React e TypeScript, com experiência em Next.js.
- PostgreSQL além do básico: modelagem, índices, consultas complexas e migrations.
- Supabase (Auth, RLS e Edge Functions) ou stack equivalente.
- APIs REST e webhooks.
- Testes automatizados e Git com revisão de código.
- Autonomia e IA: usar IA (Claude Code, Cursor ou similar) para ganhar produtividade, revisando e sabendo explicar tudo o que entrega.

**Diferenciais:**
- Integração com APIs fiscais (NF-e, NFC-e, NFS-e) já em produção.
- Gateway de pagamento (Asaas, Mercado Pago ou similar).
- Meta for Developers e API oficial do WhatsApp.
- Sistemas multiempresa (várias empresas no mesmo banco).
- Segurança de aplicações (OWASP) e LGPD.
- Publicação na Cloudflare e esteira de deploy.
- Já ter orientado ou revisado o código de desenvolvedores júnior.

## Benefícios

- 100% remoto.
- Autonomia para decidir e publicar.

## Contratação

PJ, R$ 8.000 por mês. Início a combinar.

## Como se candidatar

Pelo formulário (uns 10 minutos): https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSdYPm2pPvY8wZLFWQ-OytAXk0twbpCoHluOzSWEwVOzjPBYGg/viewform

Página da vaga: https://vagas.rothaia.com.br/pleno/

## Tempo médio de feedbacks

Respondemos as candidaturas pelo e-mail ou WhatsApp informado no formulário. Dúvidas: contato@rothaia.com.br

## Labels

- Remoto
- PJ
- Pleno

items.title: [Remoto] Full Stack Developer (React) Júnior na Rotha IA
items.description:
## Nossa empresa

A Rotha IA cria sistemas de gestão sob medida (CRMs e ERPs) para empresas de diferentes setores, com React, TypeScript e Supabase.

## Descrição da vaga

Buscamos um perfil júnior avançado para desenvolver, manter e evoluir os sistemas de gestão web dos nossos clientes, atuando no front-end, no back-end e no banco de dados.

- Desenvolver e manter aplicações web com React e TypeScript.
- Implementar regras de negócio, funções e serviços no Supabase (PostgreSQL e Edge Functions).
- Criar e consumir APIs REST e integrar os sistemas com serviços externos (nota fiscal, WhatsApp, pagamentos, automações).
- Modelar tabelas, escrever consultas e cuidar da integridade dos dados.
- Corrigir bugs reportados pelos clientes, investigando a causa da tela até o banco.
- Testar e validar as funcionalidades antes de cada entrega.
- Publicar versões e aplicar mudanças de banco em produção, seguindo o checklist da empresa.
- Participar de revisão de código e programar em dupla com o fundador.
- Documentar funcionalidades e escrever manuais para as equipes dos clientes.

## Local

Remoto (100%), Brasil.

## Requisitos

**Obrigatórios:**
- Ensino superior completo ou em andamento em Computação, Sistemas de Informação, Engenharia de Software, ADS ou área relacionada.
- Pelo menos 1 ano com React e TypeScript (emprego, freela ou projetos próprios publicados).
- Banco de dados relacional e SQL (PostgreSQL ou Supabase).
- Integração de APIs REST.
- Git no dia a dia.
- Autonomia e IA: saber gerenciar o estado da aplicação, fazer requisições HTTP e implementar autenticação, e usar IA (Claude Code, Cursor ou similar) para ganhar produtividade sem ficar dependente dela.
- Investigar um problema de ponta a ponta e explicar com clareza o que encontrou.

**Diferenciais:**
- Next.js.
- Integração com APIs fiscais (NF-e, NFC-e, NFS-e), como Brasil NFe ou Focus NFe.
- Meta for Developers e API oficial do WhatsApp.
- Segurança de dados e LGPD.
- Edge Functions e políticas de acesso (RLS) no Supabase.
- Testes automatizados.

## Benefícios

- 100% remoto.
- Horário fixo diário de programação em dupla com o fundador.

## Contratação

PJ, R$ 5.000 por mês. Início a combinar.

## Como se candidatar

Pelo formulário (uns 10 minutos): https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSdMr0CKzvQ2CN7hbaCC8ZVy4mKN-xhCCckw11pLjexaFyOsIQ/viewform

Página da vaga: https://vagas.rothaia.com.br/junior/

## Tempo médio de feedbacks

Respondemos as candidaturas pelo e-mail ou WhatsApp informado no formulário. Dúvidas: contato@rothaia.com.br

## Labels

- Remoto
- PJ
- Júnior

items.title: [Bug]: schema-invalid jobs index prevents fallback to a healthy jobs.json
items.description:
### Bug Type
Portal: website not loading or showing stale data

### Description
The browser's fallback from `jobs-index.json` to `jobs.json` handles HTTP / JSON-decoding failures, but not a successful JSON response with an invalid jobs schema. If the index answers HTTP 200 with `{ "nope": 1 }` while `jobs.json` contains valid postings, `loadJobs` returns an error and zero jobs without requesting the healthy full dataset.

Verified against `main` at `c73256709`; the relevant files are unchanged from that commit. This is a deterministic fault-injection reproduction, not evidence that production currently serves an invalid index.

### Steps to Reproduce
Run from the repository root:

```sh
node --input-type=module <<'JS'
import { loadJobs } from './site/src/data/jobs-source.js';
const calls = [];
const fetchImpl = async (url) => {
  calls.push(url);
  return {
    ok: true,
    json: async () => url.endsWith('jobs-index.json')
      ? { nope: 1 }
      : { jobs: [{ job_id: 'job_valid', title: 'Junior Engineer', company: 'Example' }] },
  };
};
const result = await loadJobs(fetchImpl, false);
console.log({ calls, jobs: result.jobs.length, error: result.error });
JS
```

Actual:

```text
calls: ['./jobs-index.json']
jobs: 0
error: 'jobs payload has no "jobs" array'
```

Expected: `jobs.json` is requested, its valid posting is returned, and `error` is null.

### Cause
In [`jobs-source.js`](https://github.com/ambicuity/New-Grad-Jobs/blob/c73256709/site/src/data/jobs-source.js), the inner `try/catch` protects only the index fetch/decode. `normalizeJobsPayload(payload)` runs after that catch, so a schema error goes straight to the outer failure handler and bypasses the fallback.

The existing “reports a malformed payload” test supplies only an invalid index. It does not provide a healthy full file or assert that fallback was attempted.

### Expected Behavior / Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Index loading is considered successful only after schema validation and normalization succeed.
- [ ] A schema-invalid index triggers a request for `jobs.json`.
- [ ] A valid full payload restores jobs and returns `error: null`.
- [ ] A valid empty index (`jobs: []`) remains a successful empty result, without fallback.
- [ ] When both candidates fail, the loader resolves with an explicit error rather than rejecting or silently reporting success.
- [ ] Add deterministic tests for invalid index + healthy full payload, both invalid, and valid empty index; cover schema-invalid Brotli index payloads as applicable.

### Validation
Reproduced with the injected fetch above. Existing checks also pass: `vitest run src/lib/share.test.js src/data/data-sources.test.js test/seo.test.js` (**50 passed**).

Searched open and closed issues for index/fallback/malformed-payload reports; no issue tracking this specific jobs-loader recovery gap was found.

items.title: [Bug]: near-miss job share links point to static pages that are never generated
items.description:
### Bug Type
Portal: broken link or incorrect data displayed

### Description
“Copy link to this job” produces a static `/job/<job_id>/` URL for a near-miss posting, even though the SEO build generates these pages only for the curated dataset. The copied link therefore points to a page the deployment does not contain.

Verified against `main` at `c73256709`. The relevant source and fixture files are unchanged from that commit. This is reproduced locally using committed fixtures; no live posting counts are asserted.

### Steps to Reproduce
1. Build the fixture site (`cd site && npm run build:fixtures`).
2. Open the board and enable **WIDEN SCOPE → internships & co-ops**.
3. Select the fixture posting `job_e001ffffffffffffffff` (Palantir, Software Engineer Intern - Summer 2027).
4. Click “Copy link to this job”. The URL is `https://jobs.riteshrana.engineer/job/job_e001ffffffffffffffff/` (or the equivalent preview origin).
5. Inspect `site/dist/job/job_e001ffffffffffffffff/index.html`: it does not exist. Opening the copied URL cannot restore that posting.

Independent local verification called `generateSeo` directly on `site/test/fixtures`: it generated 19 curated job pages, while the page for this near-miss ID was absent. Calling `jobShareUrl(mapJob(nearMiss), location)` returned the missing static-page URL.

### Cause
- [`share.js`](https://github.com/ambicuity/New-Grad-Jobs/blob/c73256709/site/src/lib/share.js) selects the static path for every valid `jobId`, without considering `nearMiss`.
- [`DashboardView.jsx`](https://github.com/ambicuity/New-Grad-Jobs/blob/c73256709/site/src/components/hiring/DashboardView.jsx) uses that helper for both curated and widened-scope rows.
- [`generate.mjs`](https://github.com/ambicuity/New-Grad-Jobs/blob/c73256709/site/scripts/seo/generate.mjs) reads `jobs.json` / `jobs-index.json`, not `jobs-extended.json`.

### Expected Behavior / Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Copied links for near misses open the board with the selected posting restored.
- [ ] The link includes every required `include` reason so the receiving browser loads the extended dataset and can display the posting, including postings with multiple reasons.
- [ ] Curated postings retain their existing static job-page links.
- [ ] Links work at the domain root and under a GitHub Pages subpath.
- [ ] Curated counts, feeds, and SEO job-page scope remain unchanged.
- [ ] Add deterministic unit coverage plus an integration/E2E case that opens a copied near-miss link in a fresh view.

### Validation and Related Issues
`vitest run src/lib/share.test.js src/data/data-sources.test.js test/seo.test.js`: **50 passed**. The gap is not exercised by those tests.

Related to #181, but distinct: the current React detail view and URL state already exist. This report concerns the wrong destination produced by the current share action specifically for the near-miss tier.

items.title: [Product Bug] Jobs auto-detected as "Applied" remain visible in "Liked" tab (cross-tab duplication)
items.description:
Hi Jobright team. Filing here because this repo is the most public-visible surface; please route to the extension / web-app product team.

### Bug

After the Chrome extension auto-detects a submitted application, the job stays in **both** the "Liked" tab AND the "Applied" tab. User has to manually un-Like each one or Liked-tab counts inflate indefinitely.

### Repro

1. Save a job to the Liked list (click heart/save on a job card)
2. Apply to that same job on the external careers page
3. Return to Jobright dashboard
4. Observe: job appears in both Applied AND Liked

### Expected

Once auto-detect flips a job to Applied, it should disappear from Liked. "Applied" supersedes "Liked" in the user's pipeline model: you don't "like" a job you've already committed to.

### Impact

Breaks pipeline tracking integrity. Any user with 20+ liked jobs who applies to a few per day accumulates a growing phantom Liked list that no longer reflects pipeline state. Appears to be a recurring class of complaint in third-party Jobright reviews (weak submission tracking).

### One-click diagnostic for your eng team

Hard-refresh the Liked tab after reproducing:

- **Duplicate persists**: backend data model issue (likely independent `isLiked` + `isApplied` boolean flags with no mutex, or separate collections with no cross-delete on apply-event)
- **Duplicate clears**: frontend cache-invalidation miss on apply-event (likely Chrome extension writes applied status without invalidating the Liked-list query)

### Fix sketch

- **Write-side**: on apply-event, set `isLiked=false` as well, OR migrate to a single `status` enum (liked / applied / interviewing / rejected) that is mutually exclusive
- **Query-side (belt-and-suspenders)**: filter Liked by `isLiked AND status != 'applied' AND status != 'interviewing'` so the bug cannot recur via other write paths

### Severity

**High**. Not critical (no data loss, no security issue), but breaks the extension's core value prop of trustworthy pipeline tracking. 200K users times this friction = material NPS impact.

Happy to provide screenshots if that unblocks routing.

工作内容

3. 管理项目进度、风险及交付质量，优化跨团队协作流程。  
任职要求
1. 2–5 年项目管理、PMO 或业务运营经验，有独立主导项目的成功案例。  
2. 具备数字资产交易平台背景，有市场活动或用户增长项目经验。  
3. 推动力强、结果导向，能够独立协调多部门解决问题，非纯执行型项目经理。  

02｜财务经理
工作内容
1. 负责多币种、多主体账务管理、财务报表及月度、年度结算。  
2. 管理冷热钱包、银行账户及链上资产，完成资金对账和差异排查。  
3. 联合产品及研发团队搭建财务核算与对账系统，推动财务流程自动化。

1. 财务、会计、金融相关专业本科及以上学历。  
2. 3 年以上 Web3 或加密交易平台财务经验，熟悉全盘账务及链上资金对账。  
3. 熟悉多币种财务管理，具备财务系统从 0 到 1 建设或相关需求落地能力。  

03｜资深量化风险专家（交易与对冲）
工作内容
1. 建立交易及对冲风险模型，管理风险敞口、保证金、流动性及风险限额。  
2. 开展市场压力测试，评估极端行情下的潜在损失和资金风险。  
3. 分析订单簿、成交及交易异常，推动风险预警与控制机制落地。  
任职要求
1. 通常 5 年以上量化风险、市场风险或衍生品交易相关经验。  
2. 熟练使用 Python、SQL，具备风险建模、统计分析及压力测试能力。

1. 研究和优化动态对冲、库存管理、资金再平衡及量化交易策略。  
2. 优化 Maker/Taker、订单路由、拆单及交易执行，降低交易成本。  
3. 研究跨市场套利、基差和资金费率机会，负责策略实盘表现及净收益优化。  
任职要求

2. 有独立主导策略研究、实盘上线及持续优化经验，能够解释收益来源和回撤。  
3. 熟练使用 Python、SQL，理解回测验证、交易成本建模及衍生品市场机制。

2. 分析订单簿、订单流及逐笔成交数据，开发预测信号和交易因子。
3. 建立交易回测与仿真模型，优化报价、执行成本、库存及对冲策略。 
任职要求
1. 数学、统计、计算机或金融工程相关专业，通常具备 2–5 年量化研究或做市经验。
2. 扎实的概率统计及时间序列分析基础，熟练使用 Python 进行策略研究及回测。
3. 熟悉高频交易、市场微观结构和衍生品机制，有实盘策略经验优先。  

04｜机构业务拓展经理（BD）
工作内容
1. 开发并维护机构客户、量化交易公司、做市商及经纪商资源。
2. 负责客户需求沟通、商务谈判、合作方案及业务落地。
3. 拓展香港及国际市场，推动机构合作和客户增长。 
4. 任职要求
1. 通常具备 2–5 年机构销售、BD 或商务合作经验。
2. 熟悉数字资产行业及衍生品交易生态，理解期货、永续合约，熟悉期权优先。
3. 中英文沟通流利，具备机构客户资源及独立商务拓展能力。 
## 工作环境
